prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: a wide Chinese community call-for-contributions banner for a GitHub research tools library, approximately 2.5:1 landscape, intended to look excellent at 850px rendered width. Create a beautifully designed warm scientific editorial illustration, matching a collection that uses warm ivory paper texture, deep navy headings, cobalt blue and pale watercolor cyan, tactile cut-paper collages and plenty of whitespace. The Chinese invitation is the dominant focal point, with a friendly confident feel.
Layout: left 58% has large exceptionally legible Chinese typography, right 42% has a refined three-dimensional paper collage showing a shared open blue research toolbox. Several useful contributions emerge from it: a research-paper card, a small node-connection card suggesting MCP, a simple software-window card, and a pencil; a subtle curved connecting line unites the items. A hand can gently place a new paper card into the collection, suggesting community participation. Maintain a coherent calm editorial style with believable paper shadows, attractive spacing and no clutter.
Text EXACTLY:
small eyebrow: "优秀科研工具征集"
large headline on two lines: "好用的科研工具，" then "一起分享出来。"
medium line: "科研技能 · MCP · 软件 · 插件 · 脚本"
bold blue rounded call-to-action label: "欢迎推荐与自荐"
small footer: "skill.createsci.com"
Only these text strings. Render all Chinese characters correctly. Keep safe outer margins and prioritize the headline and call-to-action. The entire image will be a clickable link to the submission form, so the call-to-action is appropriate. Avoid English branding headlines, fabricated screenshots or results, complex code, QR codes, robot heads, watermarks, reward claims, deadlines, popularity counters, fake endorsements and unnecessary decoration. This is an invitation illustration, not an actual software screenshot.
